thread:
maria: FYI customer request from StellarPay wants Polaris-15B in dedicated for low-latency payments use. They asked for a quantized 4-bit build and < 60ms p50 for 64-token sequences — sounds urgent (enterprise ticket #4521).
ajay: Can we get a quick signal on fidelity loss for GPTQ vs AWQ on their prompt suite? do we have their eval set?
maria: Zoe attached a sanitized eval set link (S3) in the ticket. Sharing here: s3://redwood/starpay/polaris-15b/eval-small. Zoe, brought up any contractual SLA?
zoe: They committed to reserved capacity (dedicated) + support plan; asks to prioritize. Can we scope a minimal rollout with fallback to 7b if quality drops?
ajay: Plan I'd propose: 1) baseline FP16 run on our staging cluster 2) GPTQ q4f run + AWQ q4b as comparison 3) automated eval (accuracy, exact-match, token-level perplexity) + human spot-check on top-5 failure modes 4) perf bench for p50/p95.
kevin: Infra notes: staging clusters can spin a 15B node but need to reserve GPU hours. I'll open a capacity reservation and tag as "starpay-polaris". infra-bot will confirm.
infra-bot: Reservation created: res-9812, 4x A10G for 48h starting 1918770000.
maria: Ajay — what's your rough ETA for the quant runs if I give access to cluster now?
ajay: I can run a fast GPTQ pass today (approx 4-6h) if nobody else is using the nodes. AWQ might take extra iteration. Expect basic eval metrics tonight.
kevin: Quick perf checklist for whoever runs bench:
```
redwood-bench --model polaris-15b --quant q4f --batch 1 --seq 64 --warm 100 --tokens 1024 --out perf_q4f.json
redwood-bench --model polaris-15b --quant awq_q4b --batch 1 --seq 64 --warm 100 --tokens 1024 --out perf_awq.json
```
Collect p50/p95 and GPU util. Add --trace for kernel timings if perf weird.
zoe: For rollout gating: quality delta must be < 2% exact-match regression vs FP16 on the critical payment intents. Otherwise hold and flag. Also want cost delta estimates.
ajay: Noted. Will compute per-token cost delta using token throughput numbers and infra costs.
maria: Could we also run a tiny A/B smoke with the customer's QA team? They can validate top-10 failure cases quickly. Zoe — can you coordinate?
zoe: I'll ping the customer PM. ETA for smoke review: tomorrow morning their timezone.
ajay: One more: we should run a few adversarial prompts from our regression harness (fraud-detection style prompts). I'll run those as part of the eval.
kevin: If the q4f perf meets <60ms p50 we can push a canary route on Dedicated with 5% traffic and autoscale limit 8 rps until metrics look good.
maria: Owners: Ajay -> quant + eval, Kevin -> infra reservation + canary config, Zoe -> customer coordination & gating. I'll own the ticket and doc the checklist.
ajay: Will post results as short json blob + top failure examples in this thread.
kevin: tagging ops: @oncall for potential hotfix when we flip canary.
zoe: thumbs up. timeline: quant run today, perf + eval posted tonight, canary tomorrow if passes.
maria: Thanks — anything else? If not I'll convert this into the onboarding checklist and link into the ticket. :thumbsup:
ajay: One ask: keep FP16 artifact around to compare model outputs side-by-side, and stash random seeds from quantization for reproducibility.
maria: done. Storing artifacts at s3://redwood/starpay/polaris-15b/artifacts/.
infra-bot: perf job submitted: job-66234, monitoring at https://infra.redwood/jobs/job-66234
kevin: I'll also pre-create canary config and add a fallback policy to route to polaris-7b if quality threshold fails.
zoe: Great. Posting to ticket and closing triage.
maria: Closing thread here, will update ticket with links to results.
